00047 /*  Check for GCC, Intel, of MSVC */
00048 #if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__GNUG__)   /* GNU's GCC */
00049    #define LT_COMPILER_GNU 1
00050    #if defined(__GNUC__)
00051       #define LT_COMPILER_GCC 1
00052    #endif
00053    #if defined(__GNUG__)
00054       #define LT_COMPILER_GXX 1
00055    #endif
00056    #if(__GNUC__ == 2)
00057       #define LT_COMPILER_GCC2 1
00058    #elif(__GNUC__ == 3)
00059       #define LT_COMPILER_GCC3 1
00060    #elif(__GNUC__ == 4)
00061       #define LT_COMPILER_GCC4 1
00062    #else
00063       #error PLATFORM ERROR: Unsupported version of GCC 
00064    #endif
00065 #elif defined(__ECL) || defined(__LCL)  /* Intel's VTune */
00066    #define LT_COMPILER_INTEL 1
00067 #elif defined(_MSC_VER)    /* MS Visual C/C++ */
00068    #define LT_COMPILER_MS 1
00069    #if _MSC_VER < 1300
00070       /* This compiler is older than VC7 (most likely VC6) */
00071       #define LT_COMPILER_OLD
00072    #endif
00073    #if _MSC_VER == 1300 || _MSC_VER == 1310
00074       #define LT_COMPILER_MS7 1
00075    #endif
00076    #if _MSC_VER == 1400 || _MSC_VER == 1410
00077       #define LT_COMPILER_MS8 1
00078       #ifndef _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
00079         #define _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
00080       #endif
00081       /* disable deprecation warnings (4996) */
00082       #pragma warning(disable:4996)
00083    #endif
00084    #if _MSC_VER == 1500
00085       #define LT_COMPILER_MS9 1
00086       #ifndef _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
00087         #define _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
00088       #endif
00089       /* disable deprecation warnings (4996) */
00090       #pragma warning(disable:4996)
00091    #endif
00092    #if _MSC_VER == 1600
00093       #define LT_COMPILER_MS10 1
00094       #ifndef _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
00095         #define _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
00096       #endif
00097       /* disable deprecation warnings (4996) */
00098       #pragma warning(disable:4996)
00099    #endif
00100 #endif
